record: Shiroishi City reconstruction description and dimensions
facts: The 1995 timber keep is 16.7 m above the stone base and its first level spans nine by six ken.

record: Shiroishi City history of the castle
facts: The three historic floors span nine by six, seven by four and a half, and five by three ken.
The rebuilt three-storey keep and its adjoining historic features are designated municipal properties.
